{{Infobox Slayer |name = Spiritual creatures |icon = [[File:Spiritual mage icon.png|center]] |skillreq = {{SCP|Slayer|63}}, {{SCP|Slayer|68}}, {{SCP|Slayer|83}} |combatreq = 80 |otherreq = [[Death Plateau]], {{SCP|Strength|60}} or {{SCP|Agility|60}} |krystilia = 100-150 |vannaka = 40-90 |chaeldar = 70-130 |nieve = 120-185 |duradel = 130-200 |id = 11292 }} '''[[Spiritual creature]]s''' are a potential Slayer assignment given by medium and high-levelled [[Slayer Master]]s after completion of [[Death Plateau]], a combat level of 60 and either 60 [[Strength]] or [[Agility]] with a minimum Slayer level of 63 in order to be assigned them. There are three types of spiritual creatures players can kill as part of a task: [[spiritual ranger]]s, the weakest at 63 Slayer, [[spiritual warrior|warrior]]s at 68 Slayer, and [[spiritual mages|mages]], the only NPCs that drop [[dragon boots]], at 83 Slayer. These creatures are only found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] and the [[Wilderness God Wars Dungeon]]. As followers of their respective gods, they are [[Aggressiveness|aggressive]] to anyone that is not wearing an item aligned to their god, but will be [[tolerance|tolerant]] otherwise. This is essentially required, as the dungeons are [[multicombat area]]s with many monsters, likely resulting in a swift death if this is not met. {{ToC}} In the God Wars Dungeon, players are encouraged to wear at least one [[Zamorak]]-affiliated item, as Zamorak's followers are found in all corners of the main section of the dungeon. Depending on the god that the player is focusing on, they should also bring one of that item to ensure tolerance. This is usually a [[Saradomin]] item, since [[Bandos]] and [[Armadyl]]-affiliated spiritual creatures are rarely killed. In the Ancient Prison, only a [[Zaros]]-affiliated item is required, as none of the other gods' followers are found inside. It is still recommended to bring one Saradomin- and Zamorak-affiliated item, as the player will have to run past Saradomin and Zamorak followers to reach the Ancient Prison's entrance. In the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon, it is recommended to bring three god-affiliated items: one of either Armadyl or Bandos (depending on the entrance entering from), one Saradomin, and one Zamorak. Zamorak's followers are essentially everywhere in the dungeon. The stats of spiritual creatures are generally similar, with minor variations. *Armadyl's spiritual creatures - An additional requirement of {{SCP|Ranged|70}}, along with a [[crossbow]] that can fire a [[mithril grapple]]. The rangers are the strongest, the warriors are the second strongest, and the mages are the weakest. Unlike [[Aviansie]], they '''can''' be attacked with all melee weapons. *Bandos' spiritual creatures - An additional requirement of {{SCP|Strength|70}} and a [[hammer]]. The warriors are the strongest, the mages are second strongest, and rangers are the weakest. Barring the mages, the rangers and warriors have the most health of monsters in this category. *Saradomin's spiritual creatures - No additional requirements are needed, as these are found in the main dungeon. The mages are the strongest, the rangers the second strongest, and warriors the weakest. *Zamorak's spiritual creatures - An additional requirement of {{SCP|Hitpoints|70}}, and the player will lose all prayer points upon entering Zamorak's Fortress. The mages are the strongest and cast [[Flames of Zamorak]], which drains [[Magic]] if not protected against, the rangers are second strongest, and warriors the weakest. *Zaros' spiritual creatures - The player must complete the miniquest [[The Frozen Door]], which has a requirement of 70 Strength, Hitpoints, Ranged, and Agility. The mages are the strongest, the warriors second strongest, and rangers the weakest. '''They are significantly stronger than the other gods' spiritual creatures.''' In the Wilderness dungeon, only one requirement of either 60 Agility or Strength is required. Many players tend to block spiritual creatures, since they are neither cannonable nor AFK'able, have low experience rates, and have poor drops compared to other similarly levelled monsters. Ironman players may wish to unblock the task once they have 83 slayer in order to get dragon boots. When killing spiritual creatures, players are recommended to: *Spiritual rangers - skip or block *Spiritual warriors - if killing, Zamorak's Fortress *Spiritual mages - if killing, Armadyl's Eyrie or Ancient Prison ==Slayer Unlocks== {{Main|Slayer Rewards}} {|class="wikitable sortable lighttable align-center-1 align-center-3" ! colspan="2" | Unlock ! to lose''' |} ==Safespots== '''Method 1: [[God Wars Dungeon]] (Saradomin Rangers)''' [[File:Picture Guide - Spiritual Ranger Safespot in Godwars Dungeon.png|thumb|left|970px|Picture Guide: Saradominist [[Spiritual ranger]] safespot inside the [[God Wars Dungeon]]]] '''Notes:''' * You can use the small piles of bricks to block the [[spiritual ranger]]'s. However it can be annoying as they act like you're not there and can walk off breaking line of sight and dragging you into danger. * Safe tile 1 seems optimal however as it allows you to pull rangers onto kill tile 1 and it seems the sweet spot in aggro range as the rangers keeps [[aggressiveness]]. * Then there's a ranger spawn near kill tile 2 and that ranger stays quite well contained within the bricks. * One strategy is to keep a ranger held on kill tile 1 and swap to kill the mob spawning by tile 2 as it can be tricker waiting for a ranger to walk near kill tile 1 compared to the mob on kill tile 2 constantly spawning in reach. '''Additional Notes:''' * Bring a [[saradomin item]] and [[zamorak item]] to prevent nearby mobs attacking you. * If you've completed [[Making Friends with My Arm]] ensure you've built the [[Fire of Unseasonal Warmth]] to prevent stats and run energy being drained upon entering [[godwars dungeon]]. * Bring a [[rope]] if you've never entered [[godwars dungeon]] before. {{Clear}}
